what: Decoding of the 13-digit irzcode in Natural England's SSSI Impact Risk Zones (England), field IRZURL, query parameter irzcode.
how: Digit n (1-13) belongs to the category at that position. 0: that category needs no consultation in this zone. Any other digit: consult Natural England for development matching that level's description. A level number means nothing on its own: read its text (in most categories a lower number is a lower threshold, so more development triggers consultation).

special.0000000000000: No consultation categories: Natural England's checker goes straight to 'no consultation needed' (step 3).
special.first digit 1: All planning applications need consultation; the checker skips the questions.
special.first digit 2: All planning applications except householder applications; the checker first asks whether it is a householder application.

levels.2: ALL PLANNING APPLICATIONS EXCEPT HOUSEHOLDER APPLICATIONS
levels.3: All planning applications (except householder applications) where the proposed development is outside or extends outside existing settlements/urban areas and will increase lighting levels or affect greenspace, farmland, semi natural habitats, trees/woodland, waterbodies, rural buildings/structures (manmade or natural) or linear landscape features such as hedgerows, streams and rivers through direct loss, fragmentation or change of use.
levels.4: All planning applications (except householder applications) where the proposed development is outside or extends outside existing settlements/urban areas and will increase lighting levels or affect trees/woodland, waterbodies, rural buildings/structures (manmade or natural) or linear landscape features such as hedgerows, streams and rivers through direct loss, fragmentation or change of use.

levels.1: Pipelines and underground cables, pylons and overhead cables (excluding upgrades and refurbishment of existing network). Any transport proposal including new or extended footways, cycleways, roads/car parks, railways and waterways (excluding routine maintenance). Airports, helipads and other aviation proposals.
levels.2: Pylons and overhead cables. Airports, helipads and other aviation proposals.
levels.3: Airports, helipads and other aviation proposals.

levels.1: Solar schemes with a footprint > 0.5ha, all wind turbines.
Planning applications for quarries, including: new proposals, Review of Minerals Permissions (ROMP), extensions, variations to conditions etc. Oil & gas exploration/extraction.
levels.2: Planning applications for quarries: new proposals or extensions, outside or extending outside existing settlements/urban areas affecting greenspace, farmland or semi natural habitats. Oil & gas exploration/extraction.

levels.1: Any non-residential development outside of existing settlements/urban areas where the net additional gross internal floorspace following development is 30m² or more.
levels.2: Large non-residential developments outside of existing settlements/urban areas where the net additional gross internal floorspace is > 1,000m² or the footprint exceeds 0.2ha.
levels.3: Large non-residential developments outside of existing settlements/urban areas where the footprint exceeds 1ha.

levels.1: Any residential developments with a total net gain in residential units.
levels.2: Residential development of 10 units or more.
levels.3: Residential development of 25 units or more.
levels.4: Residential development of 50 units or more.
levels.5: Residential development of 100 units or more.
levels.6: Residential development of 500 units or more.

levels.1: Any residential developments outside of existing settlements/urban areas with a total net gain in residential units.
levels.2: Any residential development of 10 or more units outside of existing settlements/urban areas.
levels.3: Any residential development of 25 or more units outside existing settlements/urban areas.
levels.4: Any residential development of 50 or more units outside existing settlements/urban areas.
levels.5: Any residential development of 100 or more units outside existing settlements/urban areas.
levels.6: Any residential development of 500 or more units outside existing settlements/urban areas.

levels.1: Any development that could cause AIR POLLUTION or DUST either in its construction or operation (including: industrial/commercial processes, livestock & poultry units, slurry lagoons/manure stores).
levels.2: Any development that could cause AIR POLLUTION (including: industrial/commercial processes, livestock & poultry units, slurry lagoons/manure stores).
levels.3: Any industrial/agricultural development that could cause AIR POLLUTION (including: industrial processes, livestock & poultry units with a floorspace > 500m², slurry lagoons > 200m² & manure stores > 250 tonnes).
levels.4: Any industrial/agricultural development that could cause AIR POLLUTION (including: industrial processes, livestock & poultry units with a floorspace > 500m², slurry lagoons > 750m² & manure stores > 3500 tonnes).
levels.5: Livestock & poultry units with a floorspace > 500m², slurry lagoons > 750m² & manure stores > 3500 tonnes.
levels.6: Livestock & poultry units with a floorspace > 500m², slurry lagoons > 4000m².

levels.1: All general combustion processes. Incl: energy from waste incineration, other incineration, landfill gas generation plant, pyrolysis/gasification, anaerobic digestion, sewage treatment works, other incineration/combustion.
levels.2: General combustion processes >20MW energy input. Incl: energy from waste incineration, other incineration, landfill gas generation plant, pyrolysis/gasification, anaerobic digestion, sewage treatment works, other incineration/combustion.
levels.3: General combustion processes >50MW energy input. Including: energy from waste incineration, other incineration, landfill gas generation plant, pyrolysis/gasification, anaerobic digestion, sewage treatment works, other incineration/combustion.

levels.1: Mechanical and biological waste treatment, inert landfill, non-hazardous landfill, hazardous landfill, household civic amenity recycling facilities construction, demolition and excavation waste, other waste management.
levels.2: Landfill. Including: inert landfill, non-hazardous landfill, hazardous landfill.

levels.1: Any composting proposal. Incl: open windrow composting, in-vessel composting, anaerobic digestion, other waste management.
levels.2: Any composting proposal with more than 500 tonnes maximum annual operational throughput. Incl: open windrow composting, in-vessel composting, anaerobic digestion, other waste management.
levels.3: Any composting proposal with more than 75000 tonnes maximum annual operational throughput. Incl: open windrow composting, in-vessel composting, anaerobic digestion, other waste management.

levels.1: Any discharge of water or liquid waste including to mains sewer.
levels.2: Any discharge of water or liquid waste that is discharged to ground (ie to seep away) or to surface water, such as a beck or stream.
levels.3: Any discharge of water or liquid waste of more than 2m³/day that is discharged to ground (ie to seep away) or to surface water, such as a beck or stream.
levels.4: Any discharge of water or liquid waste of more than 5m³/day that is discharged to ground (ie to seep away) or to surface water, such as a beck or stream.
levels.5: Any discharge of water or liquid waste of more than 20m³/day that is discharged to ground (ie to seep away) or to surface water, such as a beck or stream.
levels.6: Any discharge of water or liquid waste of more than 20m³/day to ground (ie to seep away) or to surface water, such as a beck or stream (NB This does not include discharges to mains sewer which are unlikely to pose a risk at this location).

levels.1: Any development needing its own water supply eg remote rural housing that is not connected to a mains water supply, OR large infrastructure such as warehousing/industry where the total net additional gross internal floorspace following development is > 1,000m².
levels.2: Large infrastructure such as warehousing/industry where the total net additional gross internal floorspace following development is 1,000m² or more.

source: Natural England's IRZ checker, https://irz.geodata.org.uk/IRZ/step2.html (script splits the code into ac,in,ws,og,rn,re,rr,ap,cb,wa,cp,dc,wt) and its level texts https://irz.geodata.org.uk/templates/<key><digit>.html, read 23 Nov 2026 (atlas probe round 28). User guidance: https://irz.geodata.org.uk/IRZ/guidance/SSSI_IRZ_User_Guidance.pdf
checked: All 208,189 zones read on 23 Nov 2026: 3,120 distinct codes, every non-zero digit has a level text; 1,026 zones are all zeros.
licence: Level texts are Natural England's (OGL v3.0, like the layer).
